note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename block lines 56-61; Bookmark #3: Public lighting, lines 344-384) lowercases every column and renames P04A03, P04A03A1..A4, P04A03B to l_p04a03, l_p04a03a1..l_p04a03a4, l_p04a03b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 55-60) labels each column, 6/6, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P04A03; P04A03A rows 1-4; P04A03B). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.3 (checked against the rendered page image at 250 dpi), not the dictionary labels: A1-A4 and B dictionary labels are character-identical to the questionnaire (5/5); dictionary label variant not shipped: P04A03 '¿En su vecindario tiene alumbrado público?' (questionnaire '¿Su vecindario tiene alumbrado público?'). A3's printed line break ('...funde un foco o / se derriba un poste...') joined with a single space. Structure: P04A03 (neighbourhood has public lighting yes/no) is an item with its own stem -> section _1, no prompt; the P04A03A lead-in 'De acuerdo con su experiencia, el alumbrado público de este lugar:' is shared by A1-A4 -> section_prompt of section _2; P04A03B -> section _3, no prompt. No whole-table instructions. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the skip instruction 'PASE A PREGUNTA P04A04' not shipped. Options as printed: P04A03 SÍ 1 / NO 2; A1-A4 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 'NS' (don't know) is kept as a response category on A1-A4 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A03B prints bare 1-10 bubbles (dictionary value labels = own number); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' is set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Skip pattern: P04A03=2 (NO, 1,706 households) routes to P04A04; in the source xlsx exactly those 1,706 households are blank on all of A1-A4 and B, and all 5,180 P04A03=1 households are non-blank on all five; the do-file keeps the skipped rows with resp NULL. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 24/24 valid item x resp cells equal (p04a03 1/2 = 5180/1706; a1 1/2/3 = 3388/1763/29; a2 2805/2193/182; a3 2270/2772/138; a4 156/4957/67; b 1..10 = 254/121/164/174/870/358/506/884/395/1290) and NULL cells equal source blanks (+98 for b): a1-a4 1706 each, b 1706+164=1870. Live: 41,316 rows (= 6 x 6,886), 6,886 ids (= all Hogares rows), 41,316 distinct id-item, 8,694 NULL resp (21.0%). public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of INE Guatemala's Spanish questionnaire; for items l_p04a03a1-a4, resp 3 is 'NS' (don't know), kept as a response category, and households whose neighbourhood has no public lighting (l_p04a03 = 2, 1,706 of 6,886) skipped l_p04a03a1-a4 and l_p04a03b, whose rows remain with resp NULL, as do 164 l_p04a03b rows answered 'no sabe / no responde' (code 98).
